page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance type does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

The ecs.g8i.6xlarge offers a balanced resource density profile, positioning it as a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads that require a steady ratio of compute power to memory without the overhead of specialized hardware. Appropriate workloads include enterprise application hosting, web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose business applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory. It is designed for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, enterprise application hosting, and containerized microservices.
